rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: To speak a binding sentence against
content.ART_PROMPT: A hard cracked hillside of thorns and thistles closing over a broken wooden plough and a spilled handful of seed, nothing green anywhere in the field, no people, luminous cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork, saturated full colour, a strong symbolic subject, no engraving or line art, deep shadowed background lit by one radiant golden light source, rich saturated blues and golds
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Name a card type; each player puts every card of the named type from that player's hand into Sheol. Then draw three cards from the Tower.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 3:17 — “cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: James 3:9 — “therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: The ground is cursed for the man's sake, not the man - the sentence falls on his work, and thorns are the first sign of it.
Genesis 12:3 uses two verbs: him that maketh light of thee I will bind under a curse.
Both Jesus and Paul answer the verb with its opposite - bless them that curse you, bless and curse not.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
